Hadith.2818 - Muhammad ibn Muslim narrated:
"I heard Abu Ja'far (as) say: My father told me

that the Messenger of Allah (swt), peace and blessings be upon him and his family, performed tawaf on his mount, touched the Black Stone (Hajar al-Aswad) with his staff, and performed sa‘y between Safa and Marwah on it."
